claim_boundary: Structural root-movement and existing-ledger reconciliation only. No K2P algebra, rank argument, or K2P separation certificate is used. The frozen contract is read only for graph-hash identity and mixed-edge candidate profiles; the stored K3P one-port relation is required to be exact labelled semi-directed isomorphism.

method.clean_room_root_movement: For each fully restored marginalized-incoming terminal, remove the label occupying target INCOMING, restrict and compact both sides, and exactly transport the restricted pair to its unique canonical theta seed class.
method.external_lookup: Map the semantic seed key through its ordered graph-hash pair to one unique frozen parent, map transported endpoints to unique candidate-profile site indices, require the exact one-port ledger key to be isomorphic, and require the resulting P1 ID in the canonical parent inventory.
method.site_transport: Recover the removed leaf's attachment edge on each restricted side and transport both endpoints through the canonical exact mixed-graph maps.
